'''Aloxl''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] of [[the galaxy]].

==Description==
An [[Temperature/Legends|arid]] and hot [[Planet/Legends|world]], the planet Aloxl had an unusual ellipse around its gigantic [[Star/Legends|star]] causing a 125-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] hot season, and a 25-year cool season. Uninhabitable during its hot cycle, species that could withstand high temperatures could sustain themselves below ground in subterranean [[Cave/Legends|caverns]].
